_note: Speech bubbles over a hero, purely for show (systems/dialogue.js, BattleScene.sayLine). start = the first floor of a run, clear = after a cleared floor, boss = after a boss, fallen = a squad mate fell on this floor, hurt = the speaker ended the floor at or below hurtPercent health, close = at or below closePercent (a close call; the lowest hero says it). A hero with no lines of a kind uses its clear lines. Avoid the characters $ ; @ \ ^ _ { | } ~ (missing from the font).

start: Stay behind me. All of you.
Shields up. We go down together.
Soldia's dark awaits. So do I.
clear: Not a scratch on this shield. Almost.
boss: That one hit hard. I hit harder.
fallen: I should have stood in front.
I will carry your name down there.
hurt: A dent or two. I'll manage.
close: My armour saved my life. Again.

clear: That's it? I'm just warming up!
fallen: They'll pay for that. ALL of them.
Rest, friend. I'll rage for two.

clear: Mine was the killing blow, by the way.
boss: And it never saw me coming.
fallen: Should have watched your back. Sorry.
That one wasn't part of the plan.

start: I'll cover you from the back.
clear: Clear. I'll pick up my arrows.
boss: Got it. Right in the heart.
fallen: I was too slow to cover you.
One less voice in the dark.
hurt: Arm's shaking. I can still shoot.
They got closer than I like.
Need a moment to steady up.
close: I can barely draw my bow.

start: The blade is ready. So am I.
fallen: You fought with honour.
I will finish this path for you.

start: Try not to stand in my spells.
Shall we? I have spells to test.
clear: My mana is fine. Thanks for asking.
fallen: No spell can undo that.
This was not in my calculations.
hurt: I need a better shield spell.
close: Remind me why I came down here?
I felt my life flash by. Boring.

start: May the light guide our steps.
I will keep you all alive.
clear: Patch up before the next floor.
fallen: Rest in the light, friend.
I couldn't save you. I'm sorry.
hurt: Just a moment. Let me pray.
close: Too close to meeting the gods.

clear: Mm. That smells of grave dirt.
boss: Its bones will serve me well.
Even the mighty end up still.
fallen: Don't worry. Death isn't the end.
I could bring you back. Shall I?
close: Death and I nearly shook hands.
Not yet, old friend. Not yet.

start: Let's give them a tale to tell!
clear: Hold on, I'm writing this down.
The crowd goes wild! Well, the dead ones.
boss: The ballad of the fallen beast!
Now THAT is a chorus line!
fallen: I'll sing your song forever.
A sad verse. But a brave one.
close: That was nearly my last song.
Hold the applause... I need rest.

start: My flasks are full. Let's test them.
Down we go! Bring the samples.
fallen: No potion fixes that. I tried.
I'll find a cure. For next time.
